mathematical_contract.soundness: Exact rational specializations and maximal-minor reconstruction only propose bilinear slice factors. Exact slice division and exact division of the complete trivariate tensor are required before any factor is accepted; truncating a search can only return no claim.
mathematical_contract.resource_ceiling: The existing tensor ceiling is 16384 controls. A balanced degree-24 product occupies 25^3 = 15625 controls, while degree 25 would require 26^3 = 17576. The exact-factor recursion ceiling is therefore 24 even for unbalanced tensors whose raw storage alone would allow a larger single-axis degree.
mathematical_contract.exhaustive_envelope: Axis coefficient counts four through nine, corresponding to cubic through octic degree, retain the authoritative first-factor fast pass followed by exhaustive first-Taylor and repeated-factor alignment passes.
mathematical_contract.bounded_envelope: Axis coefficient counts ten through twenty-five use a 64-proposal single-factor fast pass, then first-Taylor and repeated-factor alignment passes retaining at most 24 proved slice factors from at most 256 inspected root triples per slice call.
mathematical_contract.proposal_budget: The 256-proposal ceiling is the smallest measured power-of-two ceiling that retains the authored dense distinct and repeated nonic fixtures. A 128-proposal ceiling correctly made no claim but lost both fixtures.
mathematical_contract.recursive_budget: The useful budget is min(sum of the three tensor axis degrees, 24). Exact factor division reduces the tensor before recursion; existing symbolic sign authorities run before a zero remaining budget returns no claim.
mathematical_contract.policy: The formerly terminal nonic selected-root identity is now Certified Zero under both STRICT and APPROXIMATE_512, without consuming the approximate terminal. Unsupported factors and exhausted budgets continue to the same shared policy terminal; no tolerance or approximate geometry is introduced.
mathematical_contract.failure: Missing exact roots, exhausted root-triple proposals, failed slice or complete-tensor division, degenerate lift relations, resource overflow, unsupported coefficient towers, or exhaustion of the recursive split budget returns no exact claim. APPROXIMATE_512 remains the sole permitted 512-bit terminal path.

capability.negative_coverage: An unfactored nonic tensor is rejected on every axis; proposal truncation produces no false factor.
